# LaShawnda Holland

# LaShawnda Holland

# Director of Diversity, Equity, Inclusion + Accessibility

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/holland-profile.png)

- Promotes LGBTQ2QIA+ resources on **[the district webpage](https://www.wauwatosa.k12.wi.us/page/diversity-equity-inclusion-and-accessibility)** including a children’s hospital that promotes “puberty-suppressing hormone therapy, gender-affirming hormone therapy, surgical treatments, and speech/voice training.”
- Under her leadership, school principals created an “**[Affinity Group for Staff of Color](https://myemail.constantcontact.com/---November-Newsletter---Check-out-all-the-great-things-happening-this-month-in-Wauwatosa-.html?soid=1126177489972&aid=H8hmVPmnrDU)**.”
